rows.what_the_ink_shows: In the final corollary line, the comparison after k has a clear greater-than chevron and a separate short lower bar rising slightly to the right. It is ≥, not a bare >. See crops/136_scan029_L316.jpg.
rows.note: L316.R1: the supplied classification as his slip is contradicted by the enlarged ink. The manuscript already has k ≥ N; the original LaTeX dropped the equality bar. Correct that transcription, without appealing to its later use on scan 32.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Enlarged the final line and compared the definite > in the original. The detached lower bar is visible, so L316.R1 refines the prior finding to our misreading and restores the written ≥.
